messages:
Marta: Ask-the-room: what's one under-$10 gadget (or cheap thing) you actually use all the time and would recommend? low-cost life hacks wanted. :money_with_wings:
Devon: micro-funnel for adding oil to jars. kitchen life saver, $3.
Aiko: tiny travel toothbrush case. protects my bag, also doubles as pill container. $2.50.
Ravi: cable clips for the desk. organize chargers and stop tripping over cords. 6-pack = $5.
Grace: reusable silicone lid covers for bowls. microwave-safe and saves so many plastic wraps. $7-ish.
Oliver: portable phone stand (folding). watch recipe vids hands-free. 99 cents on sale.
Marta: @Oliver link?
Oliver: https://example.com/cheap-stand (bought a 3-pack years ago, still solid).
Devon: @Aiko the pill-container trick is genius. I travel a lot and always forget chargers.
Aiko: works surprisingly well! also great for earbuds.
Ravi: gearbot, can you log "cheap gadget recs" to #shared-resources? :robot_face:
gearbot: Logged 6 items under "cheap gadget recs" in #shared-resources.
Grace: tiny hand whisk for coffee froth. $4, makes emails feel fancy.
Marta: adding cable clips + phone stand to my cart.
Oliver: curly straw cleaner brush. indispensable for smoothies. $1.50.
Devon: binder clips as cable clamps = free if you have a desk drawer. pro tip. :clap:
Ravi: vote: cable clips vs binder clips? I'm team cable clips.
Aiko: binder clips win for me, cheaper and versatile.
Marta: thanks all! I'll compile a little list and drop it in #shared-resources tomorrow. also, if anyone has a single-source link for cheap dongles, please DM me. :seedling:
